name: deviceSummary
description: Device counts grouped by type, operating system, building, customer, service level, hardware model, manufacturer or service status

getArgs.value: {{ (() => { const ids = (sel) => [].concat(sel || []).map((o) => Number([].concat(o.rawId)[0])).filter((n) => Number.isInteger(n)); const where = []; const b = ids(typeof building === 'undefined' ? [] : building); if (b.length) where.push('d.calculated_building_fk in (' + b.join(',') + ')'); const c = ids(typeof customer === 'undefined' ? [] : customer); if (c.length) where.push('d.customer_fk in (' + c.join(',') + ')'); const r = ids(typeof rack === 'undefined' ? [] : rack); if (r.length) where.push('d.calculated_rack_fk in (' + r.join(',') + ')'); const t = [].concat(typeof deviceType === 'undefined' ? [] : deviceType).map((x) => (x && x.value) || x)[0] || ''; if (['physical', 'virtual', 'cluster', 'blade', 'other', 'unknown'].includes(t)) where.push("d.type = '" + t + "'"); const groups = {"type":"coalesce(d.type, 'unknown')","operatingSystem":"coalesce(d.os_name, '(no operating system)')","building":"coalesce(b.name, '(no building)')","customer":"coalesce(c.name, '(no customer)')","serviceLevel":"coalesce(d.service_level, '(no service level)')","hardwareModel":"coalesce(h.name, '(no hardware model)')","manufacturer":"coalesce(v.name, '(no manufacturer)')","inService":"case when d.in_service then 'In service' else 'Not in service' end"}; const by = groups[[].concat(typeof groupBy === 'undefined' ? [] : groupBy).map((x) => (x && x.value) || x)[0]] || groups.type; return 'select ' + by + ' as category, count(*) as devices from view_device_v2 d left join view_hardware_v2 h on h.hardware_pk = d.hardware_fk left join view_vendor_v1 v on v.vendor_pk = h.vendor_fk left join view_customer_v1 c on c.customer_pk = d.customer_fk left join view_building_v1 b on b.building_pk = d.calculated_building_fk left join view_room_v1 r on r.room_pk = d.calculated_room_fk left join view_rack_v1 k on k.rack_pk = d.calculated_rack_fk' + (where.length ? ' where ' + where.join(' and ') : '') + ' group by 1 order by 2 desc, 1'; })() }}
